objective: Resolve the owner-authorized BSOC backlog with per-case audit and create a fully protected System Admin new-member registration inbox showing complete available registration details without PII in alerts.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source 0a4f0b2b849f24b46b4a0643a6cc55ae539d5cdf. Verified live BUKLOD Supabase project yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu had 588 profiles, 759 open BSOC cases and 74 admin unread BSOC alerts before owner-authorized cleanup. Only direct database actions and server RPCs are live; app UI is DEV code pending separate RC and OTA.
chosenApproach: Atomically resolve 759 open user_feedback cases and write 759 case audits, clear only 74 matching System Admin alerts. Preserve original reports and never assert each underlying bug is technically fixed. Use a profile-insert trigger with only opaque user IDs, and System Admin-only paginated list/detail RPCs plus one admin inbox screen and fixed notification deep link.
selectionRationale: Live records are the source of truth. Keeping all profile PII server-side with checked admin roles and fixed routes prevents cross-account disclosure and avoids placing private details in push payloads.
alternativeApproaches: Copy registration fields into push data (rejected for privacy)
Read all auth.users directly from the client (rejected for security)
Delete reports and clear all notifications (rejected because it destroys evidence and member notifications)
preserveBehaviors: Season 1/2 rules, points, rewards, ad rendering, Wall, Connect, profile and Expo runtime unchanged
Original BSOC cases and diagnostics preserved for forensics
No ordinary user gains system-admin data access or gets alerts auto-read
New profile registration stays successful if notification delivery fails
acceptanceChecks: Verified 0 currently open BSOC user_feedback cases and 0 System Admin unread BSOC alerts after scoped administrative cleanup
Exactly 759 case-audit entries written; 74 admin alerts only marked read
Backend list and detail RPCs return current available profile/contact/address/request/scope information to System Admin; normal members are denied
New profile creation inserts one metadata-only admin notification; data is fetched live only after authorized open
Admin can navigate from dashboard and notification to complete details with missing fields explicitly labeled
No client UI OTA or production release until source checks and release gates pass

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add a secure, separate admin new registration inbox with no changes to other tabs or season rules.
preservedBehaviors: Current production navigation, AdMob, chat and profile render remain unchanged until separately verified OTA.
